Requirement Description: Evaluator shall belong to exactly one conformance group: Small, Medium, or Large.
Suggested Test: Verify document declares group; run group-specific function subset.

Requirement Description: Small Group: mandatory functions and operators as defined in Chapter 6 subset.
Suggested Test: Execute all Small-group mandatory functions; compare to expected results.

Requirement Description: Medium Group: includes all Small requirements plus additional functions.
Suggested Test: Execute Medium-group mandatory functions.

Requirement Description: Large Group: includes all Medium requirements plus remaining functions.
Suggested Test: Execute Large-group mandatory functions.

Requirement Description: Optional capabilities shall not be claimed unless implemented and documented.
Suggested Test: Audit claimed optional capabilities against source.

Requirement Description: Formula processing: expression shall be parsed according to the OpenFormula grammar.
Suggested Test: Parse a corpus of valid/invalid formulas; check accept/reject.

Requirement Description: Inline arrays shall be supported using { } with row/column separators.
Suggested Test: Evaluate {1,2;3,4} and verify matrix result.

Requirement Description: Reference range operator (:) shall produce a cell range.
Suggested Test: Evaluate SUM(A1:A3) and verify range semantics.

Requirement Description: Reference intersection operator (!) shall produce the intersection of two references.
Suggested Test: Evaluate A1:C3!B1:D2 and verify intersection.

Requirement Description: Reference union operator (~) shall produce the union of two references.
Suggested Test: Evaluate A1:B2~C3:D4 and verify union.

Requirement Description: Automatic intersection (whitespace between references) shall be supported.
Suggested Test: Evaluate SUM(A1:C3 B1:D2) and verify implicit intersection.

Requirement Description: Named expressions shall be resolvable in formulas.
Suggested Test: Define a named range and reference it in a formula.

Requirement Description: External named expressions shall be supported.
Suggested Test: Reference a named expression from another document.

Requirement Description: Quoted labels shall be supported as implicit intersections.
Suggested Test: Use a column header label in a formula.

Requirement Description: Types: Number, Text, Logical, DateParam, TimeParam, DateTimeParam, Reference, Error, Array.
Suggested Test: Type-check function results and operands.

Requirement Description: Conversion to Scalar shall be defined for each type.
Suggested Test: Convert array/single-cell reference to scalar; check result.

Requirement Description: Conversion to Number shall handle Text, Logical, Date, Time.
Suggested Test: Convert "12.5", TRUE, date serial to number.

Requirement Description: Conversion to Integer shall truncate toward zero.
Suggested Test: Convert 2.7, -2.7 to integer; verify truncation.

Requirement Description: Conversion to Logical shall treat 0 as False, non-zero as True.
Suggested Test: Convert 0, 1, -3, "" to logical.

Requirement Description: Conversion to Text shall format numbers per locale/format.
Suggested Test: Convert number to text; check formatting.

Requirement Description: Expression syntax: identifiers, operators, separators per grammar.
Suggested Test: Parse identifiers and operators; check tokenization.

Requirement Description: Whitespace handling shall be per specification (insignificant except in strings/labels).
Suggested Test: Insert spaces in formula; verify identical result.

Requirement Description: String escaping: quotes doubled inside text strings.
Suggested Test: Parse "He said ""hi"""; verify string value.

Requirement Description: Inline arrays use { } with ; row sep and , col sep (or locale variants).
Suggested Test: Parse {1|2;3|4}; verify matrix.

Requirement Description: Error constants #NULL!, #DIV/0!, #VALUE!, #REF!, #NAME?, #NUM!, #N/A.
Suggested Test: Evaluate formulas producing each error constant.

Requirement Description: Formula length and nesting limits are implementation-defined but shall be documented.
Suggested Test: Test deeply nested formula; document limit.

Requirement Description: Operators: + - * / ^ & = <> < > <= <= >= % ! : ~ shall be supported.
Suggested Test: Evaluate each operator; verify precedence and result.

Requirement Description: Operator precedence and associativity shall match OpenFormula.
Suggested Test: Evaluate 2+3*4 and 2^3^2; verify order.

Requirement Description: Prefix operators + and - shall be supported.
Suggested Test: Evaluate -5 and +3; verify sign.

Requirement Description: The % postfix operator shall divide by 100.
Suggested Test: Evaluate 50% and verify = 0.5.

Requirement Description: Function call syntax: name followed by ( argument-list ).
Suggested Test: Call functions with 0, 1, N arguments.

Requirement Description: Function parameter classification (Reference, Number, Text, Logical, etc.) per function.
Suggested Test: Pass each type to each function; verify accept/error.

Requirement Description: DATE shall return serial for year/month/day; years before 1583 implementation-defined.
Suggested Test: DATE(2020,1,1); verify serial; DATE(1500,1,1) per impl-defined.

Requirement Description: EASTERSUNDAY shall return date of Easter Sunday for year; 1583<=year<=9956.
Suggested Test: EASTERSUNDAY(2025); verify date; EASTERSUNDAY() uses today.

Requirement Description: CONVERT shall convert between units per the ODF 1.4 unit table.
Suggested Test: CONVERT(101325,"Pa","atm"); verify against ODF 1.4 table.

Requirement Description: COUNTA shall count non-empty cells including text and errors.
Suggested Test: COUNTA over mixed types; verify count.

Requirement Description: INDEX shall handle row/column/area per ODF 1.4 (removed row-vector shortcut).
Suggested Test: INDEX(rowvector,row); verify ODF 1.4 error behavior.

Requirement Description: ISBLANK/ISFORMULA/ISLOGICAL/ISNONTEXT/ISNUMBER/ISREF/ISTEXT type tests.
Suggested Test: Pass each type to each IS* function; verify logical result.

Requirement Description: NPER/PMT financial functions per ODF 1.4 definitions.
Suggested Test: NPER/PMT with known inputs; verify against ODF 1.4.

Requirement Description: Year 1583 handling: DateParam/TimeParam validity, proleptic Gregorian option.
Suggested Test: Dates around 1582-10-15; verify boundary behavior.

Requirement Description: IFNA(value,value_if_na) shall return value_if_na when value is #N/A.
Suggested Test: IFNA(#N/A,x)=x; IFNA(5,x)=5.

Requirement Description: SKEWP shall return population skewness.
Suggested Test: SKEWP over data set; verify population skewness.

Requirement Description: BITAND/BITOR/BITXOR/BITLSHIFT/BITRSHIFT bitwise operations.
Suggested Test: BITAND(6,3)=2; BITOR(6,3)=7; BITXOR(6,3)=5; shifts.

Requirement Description: Other capabilities: references to other sheets, databases.
Suggested Test: Cross-sheet reference; verify resolution.

Requirement Description: Dates before year 1583: proleptic Gregorian use is implementation-defined.
Suggested Test: DATE(1500,1,1); document chosen calendar.

Requirement Description: Non-portable features (e.g. REGEX, wildcards) shall be marked/documented.
Suggested Test: Use non-portable feature; document behavior.

Requirement Description: Appendix A: changes from ODF 1.2/1.3 to 1.4 shall be reflected.
Suggested Test: Diff test inventory against ODF 1.2 baseline.
